thinkingMessage.text:
No Go binary exists in the repository. A thorough Perl script will perform the static scan instead.

The scan will use a module prefix keying functions and methods by package path and name. Call sites will be resolved through direct same-package identifiers, aliased imports, and inferred receiver types from local variable assignments.

Method resolution will use a name-to-receiver-type map. Ambiguous calls will be disambiguated by inferring the receiver variable type. Top candidates will be validated manually with grep. Generated code is absent from internal. Test code will be tracked separately. init() calls may inflate fan-in counts.

# Count ALL internal function names by total call sites (text-based, may double-count ambiguity)
# Extract all func names from internal and count calls repo-wide
find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" | while read -r f; do
  grep -n "^func " "$f" | while IFS= read -r line; do
    ln=${line%%:*}; body=${line#*:}
    if echo "$body" | grep -q '^func ([^)]*) '; then
      name=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func ([^)]*) \+\([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p')
      recv=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func (\([^)]*\)).*/\1/p')
      rt=$(echo "$recv" | sed -E 's/.*\*?[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z0-9_.]+).*/\1/' | sed 's/.*\.//')
      sym="($rt).$name"
    else
      name=$(echo "$body" | sed -n 's/^func \+\([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p')
      sym="$name"
    fi
    rel=${f#/bench/repo/}
    # count calls excluding this declaration line
    c=$(grep -rn "\b${name}\s*(" /bench/repo --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v ":func " | wc -l)
    echo "$c $sym $rel:$ln"
  done
done | sort -rn | head -30
